smoke.title: Smoke — app loads at all
examples: App shell renders on cold load (no blank/white screen)
Primary/landing page reachable and interactive
Key data or content visibly loads
No full-page error state on the top routes

func.auth.title: Registration, login & session
examples: Login happy path completes and lands on the expected screen
Wrong credentials show a clear error without silent failure
One-time-code login happy path (if enabled)
Wrong one-time code shows a clear error, no surprise lockout
Logout clears session everywhere
Session survives reload / PWA relaunch
Malformed username/email/phone rejected with a proper message

func.crud.title: Create, read, update & delete a record
examples: Create a record, then view it reflects the entered data
Edit a field and confirm the change persists after reload
Delete flow requires confirmation and cancel aborts safely
Deleted record no longer appears in lists
Validation errors surface on required fields
Duplicate/conflicting entries handled with a clear error

func.search.title: Search & filtering
examples: Query returns the expected results
No-results query shows a designed empty state
Filters combine correctly (AND/OR as designed)
Clearing filters restores the full list
Pagination/infinite-scroll loads further results correctly
Sort order changes the result ordering as expected

func.settings.title: Account & preference settings
examples: Changing a setting persists across reload/relaunch
Toggling a feature/preference takes effect immediately
Danger-zone actions (e.g. account deletion) require explicit confirmation
Invalid input on a settings field is rejected with a clear message
Settings sync across devices/sessions where applicable

func.notify.title: Notifications
examples: Permission prompt timing (not on first paint)
Notification arrives for the relevant event
Notification deep-links into the correct screen
Opt-out is honored
Notification content matches the triggering event

input.title: Forms & input validation
examples: Required-field and format validation trigger correctly
Paste of formatted values (e.g. '1,000,000') parsed correctly
Max-length does not truncate valid input
Boundary/edge inputs (empty, zero, negative, very large) handled correctly
Leading zeros / decimal-only edge inputs handled
Whitespace stripped from pasted values
e-notation and unexpected symbols blocked where not valid

nav.title: Navigation, deep links & history
examples: Every primary nav tab/link reachable and highlights correctly
Browser/hardware back goes up one level, not exit
Deep link cold-loads correctly in the client-side SPA
Unknown route shows a branded 404, not a blank page
F5 on every route restores that route
External links open with rel=noopener
Protected deep link → login → returns to the intended page

ui.click.title: Clickability, dead elements & touch targets
examples: Every visible button/link produces an observable effect
Touch targets >= 44x44 px on mobile viewport
No overlapping tappable elements
Disabled buttons look disabled AND are inert
Double-tap on submit does not double-fire
Sticky footer CTAs not covered by keyboard/OS bars

ui.heuristics.title: UX heuristics (agent-judged)
examples: First-time-user clarity of each key screen/module
Every error state offers a next action
No spinner >5s without progress messaging
Same action labeled identically across screens
Destructive actions visually distinct
Unlabeled icons are guessable

ui.visual.title: Visual regression
examples: Key screens diffed against baselines per viewport
Dark/light mode parity
No layout shift between skeleton and loaded state beyond threshold
No missing-glyph tofu boxes
Critical widgets diffed at component level

ui.responsive.title: Responsive matrix & touch
examples: Common widths (360/375/414/768/1280) render without horizontal scroll
Modals fit the viewport with reachable close
Hover-only affordances have touch equivalents
Safe-area insets respected in standalone/PWA mode
Text not truncated at the smallest supported width

ui.states.title: Error & empty states
examples: Empty lists have designed empty states with a CTA
API 500 produces a human-readable error with retry
Maintenance-mode messaging displays correctly
Partial-data render degrades gracefully
Image-load failure shows a placeholder, not a broken-image icon

ui.content.title: Content quality
examples: Copy spelling/grammar sweep per screen
No untranslated strings leaking into the UI
No lorem/placeholder text
No broken images
No raw {placeholder} interpolations
Error tone consistent, never raw exception text

i18n.rtl.title: RTL / bidi correctness (optional, for right-to-left locales)
examples: For right-to-left locales: layout mirrors correctly (nav, back arrows point the correct direction)
LTR-isolated codes/IDs/values render correctly inside RTL text
Caret behavior correct in mixed-direction input fields
+/- and % signs render on the correct side of value chips
Parentheses and punctuation not visually flipped

i18n.typography.title: Fonts & glyphs
examples: Webfont loads (no fallback to an unstyled system font)
No fallback/tofu boxes for supported glyphs
Digits render in the brand font, not a fallback
Line-height does not clip ascenders/descenders
Tabular figures used in changing numeric columns (no jitter)

i18n.locale.title: Dates, numbers & locale formatting
examples: User-facing dates formatted per locale with correct conversion vs fixture dates
Timestamps shown in the correct timezone
Relative times (e.g. '2 minutes ago') accurate
Thousands and decimal separators consistent per locale
Correct localized month/day names
Midnight/date-boundary rows sort correctly

pwa.title: PWA behaviors
examples: Manifest valid: standalone, orientation, maskable icons, start_url
Install prompt flow; installed launch has no browser chrome
Offline cold open shows a branded offline page, not the dinosaur
SW update activates on next launch; no stale bundle left behind
App icon + splash correctness
Storage persistence requested

perf.title: Performance
examples: Lighthouse budgets pass on key pages
LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1 on a throttled connection
Slow-network first load usable with skeletons
Initial JS bundle under budget per route
No memory leak over a soak test
Long-task count during scroll within budget

net.title: Network behavior
examples: Injected API failure → UI error state, no infinite spinner
401 mid-session → clean redirect to login
Retry with backoff observable, no request storms
WebSocket messages parse correctly; reconnect after drop
Stale data marked while reconnecting
A slow API does not block unrelated UI

console.title: Console / log hygiene
examples: Zero console errors on cold load of top routes
No unhandled promise rejections during core flows
No PII logged to console
No verbose debug logs in production build
No failed asset/source-map 404s

a11y.title: Accessibility
examples: axe-core: zero critical/serious violations per key screen
Full keyboard traversal with visible focus in logical order
Focus trapped in modals and returned on close
Form errors announced via aria-live
Contrast >= WCAG AA across key UI states
Icons labeled or aria-hidden

sec.title: Security — observational black-box only
examples: Security headers present: CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, frame-ancestors
Session cookies Secure + HttpOnly + SameSite
TLS grade acceptable; no mixed content
No tokens readable in storage after logout
No secrets visible in console/page source
Service worker does not cache authenticated API responses

seo.title: SEO / meta / links (public pages)
examples: Title/description/canonical per public page
OG/Twitter cards for sharing
robots.txt and sitemap sane
Correct lang/dir attributes on <html>
No soft-404s
No broken links in public pages and footer

resil.interrupt.title: Interruptions
examples: Offline mid-flow: reconnect restores or safely resets (never half-submitted)
Tab kill + restore returns to the same route with state
Session timeout mid-form preserves or intentionally clears data with notice
OS app-switch during a timed flow (e.g. a countdown) does not break it
SW update arriving mid-flow does not hot-reload under the user

resil.persist.title: State persistence
examples: Language/theme/favorites persist across sessions
Lists/collections survive logout/login
Draft inputs cleared on logout (privacy)
Last selection/view restored on return

fuzz.title: Monkey / fuzz testing
examples: Extended gremlins random tap/scroll across key areas: zero crashes
Random unicode/emoji/RTL-override characters into text fields: no reflection, no layout break
Rapid navigation spam
Back/forward storms
Input fuzz corpus (boundaries, huge numbers, scientific notation)

xbrowser.title: Cross-browser
examples: Smoke section green on chromium/firefox/webkit
WebKit: date pickers, numeric input pad, 100vh issues
Firefox WebSocket behavior
PWA install path per engine documented and checked

data.title: Data sanity
examples: Live values/metrics within tolerance of external references
Spread/delta positive and under a sane threshold where applicable
Change math consistent with underlying source data
No visible value older than N seconds without a stale badge
Sorted lists actually sorted
Volumes/counts plausible (non-negative, not frozen)

trust.title: Critical-action confirmation UX
examples: Every irreversible action has an explicit confirm naming what/where
Costs/consequences disclosed BEFORE the point of no return
Confirm total == receipt == history row
Validity countdowns visibly tick
Ambiguous button-copy audit (confirm what, exactly?)
Emergency/undo path discoverable in a panic mindset

perf.load.title: Load & stress — behavior under pressure
examples: Sustained expected-peak load holds p95 latency and error rate within budget
Ramp past peak finds the breaking point and degrades gracefully (no crash)
A traffic spike is absorbed and the service recovers
A soak run reveals no memory leak or connection exhaustion over time
